snippet.title: Demon Spore - Co-Op Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.
